# CollegeMap

> One-stop platform for your JEE journey: from preparation to college counseling. Built by IITians, for future IITians.

## About

CollegeMap (https://collegemap.in) is an EdTech platform that helps JEE aspirants with comprehensive preparation resources, college counseling, mentorship programs, and direct access to IITians. The platform provides data-driven tools for college prediction, branch comparison, and admission guidance.

## Core Features

- **College Predictor**: Predict your chances of admission to IITs, NITs, and IIITs based on your JEE rank, category, and preferences. Uses real JoSAA cutoff data.
- **Branch Comparison**: Compare branches across different IITs and NITs with placement data, research output, faculty strength, and curriculum details.
- **JEE Preparation Resources**: Curated study materials, previous year question papers (PYQs) for JEE Mains and Advanced, and practice tests.
- **CBT Practice Portal**: Computer-Based Test practice portal simulating the real JEE exam interface with timed tests and performance analytics.
- **Talk to IITians**: Connect directly with current IITians for personalized advice on JEE preparation, college selection, and life at IITs.
- **Study with IITians**: Group study sessions and mentorship programs led by current IIT students.
- **Energy Batch**: Intensive JEE preparation batch program with structured curriculum and mentor support.
- **Blog**: Expert articles on JEE preparation strategies, IIT admissions, branch selection guides, and career guidance.
- **News**: Latest updates on JEE Mains, JEE Advanced, JoSAA counseling, and college admissions.
- **Seminars**: Free educational seminars and workshops on JEE preparation and college admissions.

## Target Audience

- JEE Mains and JEE Advanced aspirants (Class 11 and 12 students)
- Students seeking admission to IITs, NITs, and IIITs
- Parents looking for guidance on engineering college admissions in India
- Students going through JoSAA counseling process

## Technology

- React single-page application
- Hosted on Vercel
- Supabase backend for data and authentication
